title: A Letter — Language Class
simplified_paragraphs: 好久不见！ 你最近怎么样？
这个春天我很忙， 除了工作以外， 还要上汉语课。 我们的汉语课有点儿难， 因为这个汉语老师只说汉语， 不说英语。 开始我们以为她不会说英语， 后来发现她的英语非常好， 但是她不说。 不过， 上了两个月的汉语课， 我发现我的汉语进步得非常快， 尤其是听力和口语。 现在我开始喜欢这个汉语老师了， 因为她， 我们不得不每天练习汉语。
听说你开始学法语了， 你的法语怎么样了？ 老师教得好吗？ 你有多少个同学？ 你们有法语作业吗？ 一个星期上几节课？ 贵不贵？ 我的问题太多了， 请别笑我。 期待你的回信！
traditional_paragraphs: 好久不見！ 你最近怎麼樣？
這個春天我很忙， 除了工作以外， 還要上漢語課。 我們的漢語課有點兒難， 因為這個漢語老師只說漢語， 不說英語。 開始我們以為她不會說英語， 後來發現她的英語非常好， 但是她不說。 不過， 上了兩個月的漢語課， 我發現我的漢語進步得非常快， 尤其是聽力和口語。 現在我開始喜歡這個漢語老師了， 因為她， 我們不得不每天練習漢語。
聽說你開始學法語了， 你的法語怎麼樣了？ 老師教得好嗎？ 你有多少個同學？ 你們有法語作業嗎？ 一個星期上幾節課？ 貴不貴？ 我的問題太多了， 請別笑我。 期待你的回信！

english_paragraphs: haven't seen you for a long time! how have you been?

I am very busy this spring. In addition to work, I also have to take Chinese classes. Our Chinese class is a bit difficult because the Chinese teacher only speaks Chinese and not English. At first we thought she didn't speak English, but later we found out that her English was very good, but she didn't speak it. However, after taking Chinese classes for two months, I found that my Chinese has improved very quickly, especially listening and speaking. Now I start to like this Chinese teacher. Because of her, we have to practice Chinese every day.

I heard you’ve started learning French. How is it going? Is your teacher good? How many classmates do you have? Do you get French homework? How many classes do you have each week? Is it expensive? I’ve asked too many questions—please don’t laugh at me. I look forward to hearing from you!
english_full:
Dear Wang Bei:

haven't seen you for a long time! how have you been?

I am very busy this spring. In addition to work, I also have to take Chinese classes. Our Chinese class is a bit difficult because the Chinese teacher only speaks Chinese and not English. At first we thought she didn't speak English, but later we found out that her English was very good, but she didn't speak it. However, after taking Chinese classes for two months, I found that my Chinese has improved very quickly, especially listening and speaking. Now I start to like this Chinese teacher. Because of her, we have to practice Chinese every day.

I heard you’ve started learning French. How is it going? Is your teacher good? How many classmates do you have? Do you get French homework? How many classes do you have each week? Is it expensive? I’ve asked too many questions—please don’t laugh at me. I look forward to hearing from you!

Wish

all the best!

your friend,

Linda

June 30, 2025
